Product Specs Size 6540 gramsCircumference: 28.5 in/72.4 cmAirless, quiet design for indoor useDurable construction and premium surface FAQ What is the Nex Quiet Basketball? The Nex Quiet Basketball is a premium indoor basketball that lets you play anytime, rain or shine. Featuring an airless, quiet design specifically for indoor use, it feels and bounces like a real basketball.
Sized for youth boys and girls, appropriate for youth ages 5+.
Is the Nex Quiet Basketball appropriate for use indoors? Yes. The ball uses a foam composite material that dampens impact noise on hardwood, tile, and laminate. It's specifically engineered for indoor training. We recommend avoiding outdoor use on rough surfaces, which can wear the material over time.
What age is Nex Quiet Basketball designed for? The Nex Quiet Basketball is designed for players ages 5 and up.
This is a Size 6 basketball with a circumference of 28.5 inches (72.4 cm), a diameter of approximately 9 inches (23 cm), and a standard weight of 540 grams.
What is Training Ground? Training Ground is part of the Nex Playground Game Catalog of 50+ games accessible with either a 3-Month or 12-Month Play Pass. It features a collection of augmented reality drills designed to help improve coordination, agility, power, endurance, focus, and stability.
Training Ground will include basketball drills that serve both beginner and intermediate players who are interested in continuing their skill development at home.
What kinds of drills are in the Training Ground game? Training Ground covers four core areas:
Ball handling — dribbling progressions, crossovers, and change-of-pace drills
Footwork — pivot work, defensive stance, and movement patterns
Agility and coordination — reaction drills, lateral movement, and speed work
Athletic foundation — balance, body control, and spatial awareness
The drill library is updated regularly as Training Ground grows.
Do you need the Nex Quiet Basketball in order to use Nex Playground? No, the Nex Quiet Basketball is an optional accessory that will enhance your game experience, but it is not necessary. You can play all of the games in the Nex catalog without the use of any accessories and still enjoy the benefits of active play.
What improvement can my child realistically expect? Players who train consistently with Training Ground develop real, coachable skills: better ball control, stronger footwork, and improved coordination and body awareness. These are the foundational skills coaches at every level care about — and they transfer directly to team play. Training Ground works best as a complement to team practice, giving your player quality daily reps on the skills they're already building with their coach.
Can my child use Training Ground for shooting practice? Training Ground currently focuses on ball handling, footwork, and athletic foundation — not shooting or passing mechanics.
What surfaces work best? The Nex Quiet Basketball performs best on:
Hardwood floors — best dribble response and quietest bounce
Tile and laminate — works well; slightly more echo than hardwood
Low-pile carpet — good for footwork drills, reduced dribble height
High-pile or shag carpet will limit dribble height and is not recommended. The ball is not designed for outdoor use — rough pavement will wear down the foam surface.
What if the ball is damaged or doesn't work as expected? We stand behind the quality of the Nex Quiet Basketball. If you experience a defect or issue with the ball or the Training Ground game, please contact Nex support at hello@nexplayground.com and we'll make it right.
